name: Delaware
overview: Delaware's statewide senior-credit framework allows school districts to authorize a credit against regular school property taxes on a qualifying principal residence.

programs.name: Senior School Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ as of June 30 immediately before the county fiscal year.
programs.incomeDefinition: Not income-tested under the statewide program.
programs.incomeLimits: No income limit listed for the statewide credit.
programs.maximumBenefit: Statutory ceiling is 50% of eligible regular school property tax, up to $500; district authorization can provide less.
programs.formulaSummary: District-authorized nonrefundable bill credit, no greater than the lesser of half the eligible regular school levy after applicable reductions or $500.
programs.application: Apply to county ordinarily by April 30; annual reapplication generally unnecessary. A statutory financial-disability filing-date waiver may apply.
eligibilityNotes: Residency waiting periods depend on when Delaware domicile began; newer arrivals generally require ten consecutive years. Statute measures the required duration on June 30 immediately before the county fiscal year.
Prior-year property taxes must have been paid in full.
Actual school-district authorization and eligible school-tax amounts must be established; the statewide ceiling is not an automatic award.
interactions: Under 14 Del. C. section 1917(d)(4)e, a claimant qualifying for both the disabled-veteran and senior school credits receives the disabled-veteran credit and cannot claim the senior credit.
The treatment of separate county exemptions is not established.
programs.programYear: 2025 application cohort: ordinary filing by April 30, 2025 and age/domicile qualification on June 30, 2025 for the upcoming county fiscal year. The corresponding county bill periods are not established.

programs.name: Real estate tax itemized deduction
programs.incomeDefinition: Federal income rules govern the applicable tax deduction limit.
programs.incomeLimits: Federal rules can lower the combined limit at higher income.
programs.maximumBenefit: Taxes count toward a combined itemized deduction limit.
programs.formulaSummary: Include qualified real estate taxes on PIT-RSA, line 5c. The combined limit applies on line 5f.
programs.application: File PIT-RSA with the 2025 resident income tax return if you itemize deductions.
eligibilityNotes: Claim qualifying real estate taxes you paid during the tax year.
interactions: Other deductible taxes can use part of the combined limit.

sources.title: 2025 PIT-RSW state and local tax deduction worksheet

researchNotes: The agency overview and current statutory framework state a $500 ceiling; a proposal to raise it does not change the enacted amount.
District-specific authorization for 2025 is not recorded comprehensively. The statewide ceiling does not establish the authorized amount for a particular district.

The linked form measures domicile duration before application, while the statute uses June 30 before the county fiscal year. The statutory date governs; district, property and billing facts determine a particular claim.
